plain_english_policy: This bill is a ceremonial resolution that formally commends Tuskegee University for winning the Southern Intercollegiate Athletic Conference (SIAC) Basketball Championship. It recognizes specific achievements, including defeating Clark Atlanta in the final game and freshman Calvin Thomas being named Most Valuable Player.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would produce no change to law or public policy other than officially recording legislative commendation for Tuskegee University's athletic success.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors affirmatively advanced a resolution to honor the university team. Do not infer positions beyond this commendation.
evidence_quotes: "COMMENDING TUSKEGEE UNIVERSITY ON WINNING THE SOUTHERN INTERCOLLEGIATE ATHLETIC CONFERENCE BASKETBALL CHAMPIONSHIP."

"WHEREAS, it is with great pride and pleasure that Tuskegee University's Golden Tigers are commended and congratulated for winning their first Southern Intercollegiate Athletic Conference (SIAC) Tournament Championship in 31 years;"
